style.summary: Huckleberry sets slate navy #45526A text on white screens, with color-coded logs: cyan sleep, orange feeds, yellow diapers and purple pumping. Controls are circles, pills and 34 pt segmented bars, and green #8FD33D marks the selected segment and the Save button. Store shots float white phones over ice-white #F3FFFF and aqua backdrops.

traits.label: Layout
traits.text: 15 to 19 pt side margins; forms stack labeled sections split by thin rules, with a full-width Save pill at the bottom.

traits.label: Shapes
traits.text: Segmented controls round at 4.2 pt, choice buttons are about 80 pt circles, and Save is a full-width pill.

traits.label: Color
traits.text: Slate navy #45526A text on white; cyan #36D2E9 sleep cards and charts; orange #FD763F feeds; green #8FD33D selections and Save.

traits.label: Type
traits.text: One unnamed geometric sans with a single-story a, close to Lexend: 23 pt Medium titles, 16 pt Light tabs.

traits.label: Imagery
traits.text: White phones sit on aqua backdrops with 4-point sparkles; tip cards use flat figure drawings, food logs use cut-out photos.

traits.label: Components
traits.text: Color-coded log cards, a 167 pt cyan sleep donut with 2 pt gaps, and 138 pt orange LEFT and RIGHT nursing timer buttons.

Huckleberry pricing on the Yearly tab: Premium, best value, $9.99 a month billed yearly with $14.99 struck
Huckleberry Plus card: $5.74 a month billed yearly with $11.99 struck, and 3 highlights

ourRead: Yearly opens first and crosses out the monthly price: $14.99 sits above $9.99 a month, billed yearly, though $119.99 / 12 is $10.00. Premium’s year reads as 33% off.
Plus is the decoy on Monthly: $11.99, $3 under Premium’s $14.99. On Yearly it turns into the bargain, $5.74 a month, 52% off against Premium’s 33%.
Free keeps every log and caregiver sync at $0. Plus sells SweetSpot nap predictions for $5.74 a month; Premium adds Berry AI chat and sleep plans for $9.99 a month.
stylePrompt:
Restyle my app in Huckleberry's style. Keep my features, data and copy.
Colors:
- 60% ice white #F3FFFF: backdrops and onboarding; screens and cards stay white.
- 30% berry cyan #31BCD3: sleep data, charts and selected ranges; cards use its twin #36D2E9.
- 10% leaf lime #CDCC04: brand accents; selected segments and Save use green #8FD33D.
- Text slate navy #45526A, labels #888888; feeds orange #FD763F.
Type:
- Headlines: Lexend 500, about 23 pt.
- Body: Lexend 400, 14 to 16 pt; Lexend 300 for tabs and stat labels.
Shapes:
- Segmented controls 34 pt tall, 4 pt corners, 1 pt #E5E4E9 borders.
- Choice buttons: about 80 pt circles. Main action: a full-width pill.
Layout:
- 15 to 19 pt side margins; form sections split by thin rules.
Components:
- Log cards: one color per type, with icon, title and time since.
- Donut: 167 pt, a 21 pt ring with 2 pt white gaps, the total centered.
- Range picker: 7D to 1Y, the selected label in a 45 pt cyan circle.
Icons and imagery:
- Rounded navy line icons; flat tip drawings; 4-point sparkles on backdrops.
Check:
- Titles and body text are slate navy #45526A.
- Each log type keeps one color on every screen.
- Selected states are cyan or green fills.
